name: VO2 5x3 trained 47
description: Five 3 min reps at 12.0 km/h level 4 with 2.5 min jog recoveries: more grade than the 4 x 4. Needs --running-mode, handrail up. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, building gently. Last minutes just under the first rep pace.

steps.name: VO2 3 min
steps.notes: RPE 8-9: hard but controlled; the last rep matches the first.

steps.name: Recover
steps.notes: Easy jog or walk; let the breathing drop.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Jog then walk until the breathing is calm.
